AWSEBRDSDatabaseProperties.Description: Properties associated with the RDS database instance

AWSEBDBPassword.Description: The master password for the DB instance.

LogPublicationControl.Description: If true customer service logs will be published to S3.

DocumentRoot.Description: Enables you to specify the child directory of your project that is treated as the public-facing web root. If your root document is stored in your project directory, leave this set to "/". If your root document is inside a child directory (e.g., <project>/public), set this value to match the child directory. Values should begin with a "/" character, and may NOT begin with a "." character.

ZlibOutputCompression.Description: Specifies whether PHP should use compression for output. (This value is written to the php.ini file.)

InstanceType.ConstraintDescription: must be a valid EC2 instance type.

ProxyStaticFiles.Description: A mapping from virtual path to physical path.

XRayEnabled.Description: Enables AWS X-Ray for your environment.

DisplayErrors.Description: Specifies whether error messages should be part of the output. (This value is written to the php.ini file.)

AppSource.Description: The url of the application source.

MaxExecutionTime.Description: Sets the maximum time, in seconds, a script is allowed to run before it is terminated by the environment. This helps prevent poorly written scripts from tying up the server.

MemoryLimit.Description: Specifies the amount of memory allocated to the PHP environment. (This value is written to the php.ini file.)

AWSEBDBName.Description: The DB Name of the RDS instance

AWSEBDBUser.Description: The name of master user for the client DB Instance.
AWSEBDBUser.ConstraintDescription: must begin with a letter and contain only alphanumeric characters

AllowUrlFopen.Description: Specifies whether the PHP's file functions are allowed to retrieve data from remote locations, such as websites or FTP servers. (This value is written to the php.ini file.)

ComposerOptions.Description: Sets custom options to use when installing dependencies using Composer through composer.phar install

Metadata.ForcingMetadataUpdate: Changing something in the metadata will force re-compuation

Metadata.Description: Elastic IP Address used as entry point of Single Instance Environment
